Name: Aether (Project Genshin) - Fashion Sense (FS) and Farmer Portraits (FP)
Author: Arknir27
Description:
[size=3]Play as Aether from Genshin Impact. This is the prelude to my upcoming Project Genshin Overhaul. Requires [b]aedenthorn's [/b]framework, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11398]Farmer Portraits[/url] and [b]PeacefulEnd's [/b]framework, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]. Special thanks to these amazing mod authors![/size]

[center][img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/842533649337286677/994359091931648083/Aether_Player_Walk.gif[/img][/center]

[size=3]Includes two portraits of the Farmer/Aether with configurable expressions: the default smiling portrait and optional neutral expression.[/size]

[center][img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/842533649337286677/994355075709403327/the_real_one.png[/img][/center]

[color=#444444].
.[/color]
[center][img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/936087703768956949/994361829675507732/Fashion_Sense.png[/img]
[color=#444444].[/color][/center][left][size=3]Dress up in the unique Traveler attire using the Hand Mirror. Includes four different shirts that correspond to different visions: Anemo, Dendro, Electro, & Geo. Switch up your elemental powers at will.
Also includes animated hair, scarf/cloak accessory, and pants.
[/size][/left]
[b][size=4]Hand Mirror Tutorial:[/size][/b]

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/842533649337286677/994329699209719878/FS_Mirror_Tutorial.gif[/img]

[b][size=4]How to enable the Farmer/Aether Portraits in-game:[/size][/b]

[size=3]Using the [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][size=3], enable all the checkboxes in the image below under the "[/size][b]Farmer Portraits[/b][size=3]" mod.
[/size]
[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/842533649337286677/994356640776196116/Configs.png[/img]
[size=2]*Also keep in mind that you may need to lower the zoom level of the UI interface in the settings in-game for portraits to show properly.[/size]

[size=3]Want to track my progress on Project Genshin Overhaul? You can check my Project Genshin Showcase on my [url=https://ko-fi.com/album/New-Album-V7V0CWKOA]Ko-fi here[/url]﻿. I am also active in the East Scarp discord.[/size]

Downloads.Description:
Requires latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher. Make sure to have PeacefulEnd's Fashion Sense and aedenthorn's Farmer Portraits installed first.

- Download this mod & unzip all attachments into Stardew Valley/Mods

- Run the game using SMAPI
